SAMAN Portable manufactures container offices in Bhiwadi as a direct factory, not a marketplace reseller. We have built modular steel cabins since 2009 and completed 500+ projects across India. Units for Bhiwadi are fabricated at our Greater Noida works and sent by road to sites across the RIICO industrial area, Khushkhera, Chopanki, and the Tapukara auto belt. At about 170â€“200 km, most Bhiwadi orders reach the site in 2â€“3 days once the build is ready.

A container office is a factory-built steel cabin that arrives finished and ready to use. It gives you a clean, lockable, weather-proof workspace without the time, cost, and mess of on-site civil construction. For one of the NCR's largest industrial hubs â€” auto and auto components around Honda's Tapukara plant, steel, cables and wires, ceramics and sanitaryware, chemicals, engineering, and warehousing across the RIICO phases â€” a container office is the quickest way to put a site office, admin cabin, or security post exactly where the work is.

How we build our container offices

Every unit starts with a mild steel frame in IS 2062 structural steel, welded and treated to hold up through Bhiwadi's hot, dusty summers and cold winters. The base sits on a channel frame so the cabin stays off wet or dusty ground. Walls use insulated PUF sandwich panels, or cement board with rockwool, so the inside stays comfortable through the harsh temperature swings. The roof is profiled GI sheet with a slope for rain runoff. Flooring is marine ply with vinyl for office use, or chequered MS plate for heavy gate and store cabins on busy factory yards. A standard fit-out covers electrical wiring with switches, points, LED lights and a distribution board, powder-coated windows with grille and shutter, and a steel or laminated door with a lock. We add air-conditioning, toilets with plumbing, pantry units, and internal partitions when a site needs them.

Common sizes for Bhiwadi sites

Popular configurations are 10Ã—8 ft and 10Ã—10 ft for a single supervisor, guard, or weighbridge cabin, 20Ã—8 ft (the standard shipping-container footprint) for a site office that seats a small team, and 40Ã—8 ft for larger project offices with two or three rooms. We also fabricate to custom dimensions, and stack units in double-decker form where ground space is tight â€” a common request on packed RIICO and Tapukara plots. If you are unsure of the size, tell us the headcount and how the cabin will be used and we will suggest a layout that fits your plot.

Where they are used around Bhiwadi

Buyers in the Bhiwadi region use our cabins as admin and supervisor offices for auto, cable, and engineering units across the RIICO industrial area (301019), site and supervisor office cabins for auto-component plants in the Tapukara belt near the Honda plant (301707), gate and security cabins for warehouses and logistics yards, weighbridge and store cabins for the Khushkhera and Chopanki phases (301019), and construction site offices on new factory and road projects. For heavy factory yards that need a rugged unit, we build heavy-duty cargo-style container offices with reinforced flooring and extra power points.

Customization and price factors

Because every unit is made to order, the price in Bhiwadi depends on the size, the panel type (PUF costs more than cement board but insulates far better through the temperature swings), the flooring, and add-ons like air-conditioning, a toilet, a pantry, or extra electrical load for machines. Colour, branding, window and door count, and internal partitions are all your choice. We confirm the final quote after a short requirement discussion rather than showing a fixed sticker price that would not match your actual build â€” so you pay for the cabin you need, not a template. Compare our specifications against any marketplace listing: the difference is that you are dealing with the factory that welds the frame, not an agent forwarding your enquiry to someone else.

Delivery, warranty, and certifications

Delivery to Bhiwadi is charged at â‚¹3,000 where applicable, with road transit of about 2â€“3 days once the unit is ready â€” Bhiwadi is a short run from our Greater Noida factory. We also offer a 7-day return window, with return shipping paid by the customer. SAMAN Portable operates under ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and is registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). Our container offices carry a 5-year structural frame and base warranty, 1â€“2 years on finishing, and a 20â€“25 year engineered service life for the steel structure â€” real, verifiable credentials that a marketplace listing cannot show you.

Why buy from SAMAN

Search for a container office on a directory and you get a page of resellers competing on the same stock photos. Enquire with SAMAN and you reach the manufacturer directly â€” honest specifications, real size options, transparent price factors, and one point of accountability from fabrication to dispatch. See the container offices we build to order to understand the standards we build to, and our work across the wider NCR-Rajasthan belt â€” container offices reaching the Delhi region, container cabins supplied to Chandigarh, and container office work across the Jaipur region â€” shows the same build quality reaches every Rajasthan and Haryana site.

Frequently asked questions

Do you deliver container offices to Bhiwadi and the RIICO industrial area?
Yes. We manufacture at our Greater Noida factory and dispatch by road across the Bhiwadi RIICO industrial area, Khushkhera, and Chopanki (301019), and the Tapukara belt (301707). Transit is usually 2â€“3 days once the unit is built, with delivery charged at â‚¹3,000 where applicable.

What container office sizes suit Bhiwadi factory and site use?
Common sizes are 10Ã—8 ft and 10Ã—10 ft cabins, 20Ã—8 ft site offices, and 40Ã—8 ft project offices. We also build custom dimensions and double-decker units for packed RIICO and Tapukara plots.

What does a container office cost in Bhiwadi?
Price depends on size, panel type, flooring, and add-ons like AC or a toilet. Since every unit is made to order, we confirm the final quote after a short requirement discussion so the figure matches your exact build.

Can the cabin be customised for auto, engineering, and warehousing units?
Yes. We add AC, toilets, pantries, partitions, extra power points, and heavier flooring for gate or store use, and we match the layout, colour, and window and door count to your site.

Talk to the manufacturer. For container offices anywhere in the Bhiwadi region, call our North zone team on +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or use Send Enquiry with your size and site details for a made-to-order quote.
